notes.plan_id: <brochure>-<option>, e.g. 02AP-01-High; brochure numbers are identical in 2026 and 2027, so they join the years.
notes.rates: rates[plan][region][self|self_plus_one|family] = {biweekly_active, monthly_retiree}; vision plans use region 'all'. Region '0' (some nationwide dental carriers) is OPM's International rating: it equals the region listed in geo.international_region[brochure] and no ZIP maps to it. Region ids are per brochure (carrier) and not comparable across carriers.
notes.benefits: benefits[plan][rowkey] = {text (OPM wording), value?, unit? (usd|pct|months|unlimited), approx?}. Unprefixed keys are In-Network 1; in2_ / oon_ prefixes are In-Network 2 / Out-of-Network. meta.board lists sections and rows (rows with source 'rates' are premiums read from rates). Class coinsurance value is the member's share.
notes.geo: years[y].geo.zip3[zip3].regions[brochure] = rating region. Eligible plans = geo.brochure_plans[brochure] for every brochure present; a brochure absent from a ZIP3 is not offered there. 'mixed' lists brochures whose region differs by ZIP5 inside that ZIP3 (use geo.zip5_regions[zip5]).
notes.zip_precision: OPM publishes eligibility and region per ZIP5, but within every ZIP3 each plan is offered in all of its ZIP5s or none, so lookups are exact at ZIP3 plus the zip5_regions overrides. ZIP5 -> state: zip3_to_states, with zip5_state_exceptions for ZIP3s spanning several states. ZIPs OPM labels 'No State Mapping Found' carry no state. This table lists only ZIPs present in OPM's file, so an unknown ZIP5 is not validated.
notes.limits: OPM's public benefits file is a flat summary: no waiting periods for preventive/basic/major, no network type (PPO/HMO/indemnity), no vision dollar allowances, and no contact-lens detail beyond the 'Additional Features' text.
